title: fix: create the polli gen --output folder before the request
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix `polli gen image|video|audio|text|3d|isolate|voice-change --output some/missing/dir/file`: the CLI now creates the folder before the paid request instead of failing with ENOENT after it
- A folder that can't be created (bad path, no permission) now fails before any request is sent, so nothing is billed
- Adds a test that `gen 3d --output out/nested/fox.glb` saves into a new folder

Fixes #15556

gist.headline: Make the nest before the egg
gist.blurb: Polli makes the output folder before sending a generation request. If the path won't cooperate, the request stays put—and so does your Pollen.
gist.summary: The polli CLI creates missing --output directories before paid image, video, audio, text, 3D, isolate, and voice-change requests, and stops before sending a request if the directory cannot be created.
gist.impact: A command such as polli gen 3d --output out/nested/fox.glb saves into a new folder; an invalid or unwritable path fails before anything is billed.
